svg.title: Separate image, mask and spatial representation
svg.desc: Original synthetic chamber-shaped image, threshold mask, and interior square-grid sketch. Inlet and outlet labels identify artificial boundaries. This is not a patient image, anatomical segmentation, or a solver-ready CFD mesh.
